name: Anna Wenner

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Fred Meir (Frederick Meier); licence No. 714, sworn 28 Apr 1886. She gave her birth as 15 August 186[?].

events.title: Widowed
events.description: In Feb 1918 she was living at Hazleton, in domestic service, and her husband Fred was dead. Her birthplace is given as Hazleton, Pa.

bioAdditions: Annie Wenner married Frederick Meier at Hazleton on 12 May 1886, giving her birth as 15 August (year partly legible) (S1). FamilySearch has Aug 1861. Her daughter Agnes's 1918 marriage docket names her as 'Anna, maiden name Wenner', of Hazleton, in domestic service and born at Hazleton, with Agnes's father Fred already dead (S2). FamilySearch gives her death as 1940 (S3).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Named in her own and her daughter's marriage records.
